script.title: BUYING THE RIGHT DOG FOOD
script.story_hook: Picking the right food at a pet store.
script.intro_zh: 在寵物店幫新小狗挑對飼料。
script.welcome_en: Hi friends, welcome back! Today we're buying dog food.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨朋友們，歡迎回來！今天我們來買狗飼料。
script.outro: That's all for today! Keep listening and see you next time.
script.outro_zh: 今天就到這裡！繼續聆聽，下次見。
script.practice_intro_en: Now listen and repeat each sentence after me.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在跟著我，一句一句聆聽並跟讀。
script.char_a_description: a cheerful young woman in her mid twenties with straight blonde hair in a ponytail, wearing a rust orange hoodie and ripped blue jeans, tapping her phone in one hand
script.char_b_description: a patient bearded man in his late thirties with short faded brown hair, wearing an olive green store vest over a gray long sleeve shirt and a name tag, leaning on the counter
script.youtube_title: 【🐕幫狗挑對飼料🛒】「有小一點的包裝嗎？」超實用寵物店英文，聽完就會買｜Buying Dog Food🐾
script.youtube_title_en: “Come in a small bag?” — Buying the Right Dog Food
script.youtube_description:
第一次養狗，不知道怎麼幫牠挑飼料？這段超真實的寵物店對話，一次幫你學會！跟著客人從幼犬配方、無穀飼料、袋裝大小到試吃包，完整用美式日常英語問清楚。整段 18 句，附繁體中文翻譯與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，聽一遍就敢開口用。
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱我們的頻道，每天一集，讓英語變成你的直覺！
script.youtube_description_en:
New dog owner and not sure what food to buy? This super-realistic pet store chat teaches you in one listen. Follow the customer through puppy formula, grain-free options, bag size, and samples, all in natural everyday American English with IPA. Repeat every line in the second half and speak up today.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🐕飼料選購英文｜挑幼犬配方・確認無穀・選袋裝｜聽完就會買｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
剛領養小狗，卻不知道怎麼挑飼料？
無穀、袋裝大小，用英文到底要怎麼問？

這一集帶大家走進一家寵物店，跟著客人從幼犬配方、無穀飼料、袋裝大小，到試吃包與餵食表，全程都用自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
🐶 挑對配方：例如「food for a new puppy」、「puppy formula, not adult food」。
🌾 確認無穀：例如「Is this bag grain-free?」、「this one has no grains at all」。
🛒 選擇大小：例如「Does it come in a small bag?」、「only the fifteen-pound size here」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

看完記得實戰一次，原來幫狗買飼料可以這麼簡單！
script.thumbnail_action: holding a bag of puppy food

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I need food for a new puppy.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪ niːd fud fɔr ə nu ˈpʌpi/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我需要為新小狗買飼料。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Congrats! How old is your little one?
dialogue.phonetic: /kənˈɡræts haʊ ˈoʊld ɪz jɔr ˈlɪtəl wʌn/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She's about four months, a tiny terrier.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃɪz əˈbaʊt fɔr mʌnθs ə ˈtaɪni ˈtɛriər/
dialogue.zh: 她約四個月大，一隻小小的㹴犬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then get puppy formula, not adult food.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ɡɛt ˈpʌpi ˈfɔrmjələ nɑt əˈdʌlt fud/
dialogue.zh: 那就選幼犬配方，不是成犬的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it. Is this bag grain-free?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt ɪz ðɪs bæɡ ɡreɪn fri/
dialogue.zh: 知道了。這包是無穀的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, this one has no grains at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðɪs wʌn hæz noʊ ɡreɪnz æt ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 是的，這包完全不含穀物。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. She gets itchy skin sometimes.
dialogue.zh: 太好了。她有時候皮膚會癢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Grain-free often helps with that, actually.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪn fri ˈɔfən hɛlps wɪð ðæt ˈæktʃuəli/
dialogue.zh: 其實無穀對那種情況常有幫助。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great. Does it come in a small bag?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt dʌz ɪt kʌm ɪn ə smɔl bæɡ/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry, only the fifteen-pound size here.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，這裡只有十五磅的尺寸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, that's a lot for one puppy.
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌm ðæts ə lɑt fɔr wʌn ˈpʌpi/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，對一隻小狗來說有點多。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It stays fresh; the bag reseals nicely.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt steɪz frɛʃ ðə bæɡ riˈsilz ˈnaɪsli/
dialogue.zh: 它會保持新鮮，袋子能重新封口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I'll trust you on this one.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ aɪl trʌst ju ɑn ðɪs wʌn/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart move. Want samples to try first?
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑrt muv wɑnt ˈsæmpəlz tu traɪ fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 聰明選擇。要不要先拿試吃包？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes please, that'd give me a backup.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs pliːz ðæd ɡɪv mi ə ˈbækˌʌp/
dialogue.zh: 要的，那樣我就有個備用的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here you go, plus a feeding chart.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ju ɡoʊ plʌs ə ˈfidɪŋ tʃɑrt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You've been so helpful, thank you!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anytime! Come back for refills, okay?
dialogue.zh: 隨時歡迎！吃完再來買，好嗎？
